biggest_catch: The catalog claim of $1 is NOT supported by official pages — GoTranscript's own site states pay 'up to $0.60 per audio or video minute' ($150 average earnings per month). Zero guaranteed tasks; work is self-claimed from a dashboard pool.
catches: Catalog claim '$1' is not supported: official company pages state pay 'up to $0.60 per audio or video minute' — the $1 figure is unsubstantiated.
Zero guaranteed tasks: after approval you pick files from your dashboard — 'no forced assignments' means no promised volume.
You must pass a quiz (100% correct using their guidelines) plus a transcription test job — unpaid tests; review of the test can take up to 60 days.
New transcribers with a 3.6-or-lower average rating after 3 files can be removed from the team (per the official guidelines video).
Pay is per audio minute of the file, not per work hour — effective hourly pay can be low on difficult audio.
Payout options depend on your region — see Payouts/Billing settings only after approval.
Application includes SMS verification, face photo, and real-time photo with verification code on paper (anti-account-sale safeguards).

steps: Go to https://gotranscript.com/transcription-jobs, choose your language from the application links, and apply.
Study the GoTranscript transcription guidelines, then complete the quiz 100% correctly (questions can have multiple correct answers).
Complete the test job: transcribe the provided audio using clean verbatim, no timestamps.
Submit for review (reviewing can take up to 60 days; it can be faster if you share the job offer).
After approval, pick audio/video files from your dashboard — no forced assignments — and transcribe them by the listed deadline.
Maintain a high accuracy rating (above 4.5 qualifies you for editor work); editors review samples of your work.
Get paid weekly — every Friday via PayPal or Payoneer (the company covers the PayPal fee); no minimums.
timing: Weekly payouts every Friday via PayPal or Payoneer; no minimums.
